provenance: blind generalization: truth derived from the contract and the sources without consulting tool output or implementation
source_of_truth: Read by hand. All three components are exported from index.ts and each starts with an HTML doc comment, so none is undocumented. InlineNotice.vue has two root elements (<UAlert v-if="$slots.title"> and <div v-else>) with no props, emits or models and a script holding only defineOptions; the contract's wrapper is a component that renders a library component AT ITS ROOT, and a two-root template has no single root, so it is owner project, wraps null, and cannot be a pass-through. AppSelect.vue spreads `selectProps` imported from ./select.props into defineProps: props.resolution is spread-from-import, which the contract reports only as the info-level props-partially-resolved (not a defect; listed in out_of_scope); it also declares a model, so it is not a pass-through either. AppButtonLink.vue wraps UButton at its root but declares props (to, label) and an emit (navigate) — a legitimate wrapper. No component fetches data and no file carries an @ds-ejected marker. A correct auditor raises no confirmed or heuristic finding.

forbidden.why_not_a_defect: two root elements (UAlert v-if / div v-else): no single library root, so it is not a library-wrapper at all, even though it has no props, emits or models
